events.title: Demo Hotfix
events.summary: Thanks for your feedback! This hotfix addresses several issues encountered after completing the demo.Fixed the Play button becoming unresponsive after finishing the demo.Fixed an exploit that could refund scripts spent in the Compendium while keeping purchased upgrades.Future completed demo runs will now correctly appear as wins in the run history.Added a Play Again button to the demo completion screen.Upgrade offers now display the actual number of levels gained when approaching the level cap.A

events.title: The SU-93 Survivor demo is now available!
events.summary: Hello everyone,The SU-93 Survivor demo is finally available on Steam!SU-93 Survivor is a tactical survivor-like where you progress room after room inside a corrupted robot. Each room is a new fight, a new choice, and a new opportunity to adapt your build.The twist is simple:Your weapons can change between rooms, but your passive items stay and shape your entire run.This means you constantly have to rebuild your arsenal around the synergies you have already collected. events.title: SU-93 Survivor: Playtest Now!
